page_title: VIL 2-2 RSO | Villarreal v Real Sociedad 20/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Guillermo Cuadra has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+8' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) has too much to say to the referee and is cautioned.
90+8' Kiko Femenia (Villarreal) fails to control his temper and is booked by the referee for dissent.
90+8' Villarreal can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90+7' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Alex Remiro shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The referee points to the corner flag and Villarreal will take a corner.
90+7' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Villarreal due to a foul in the build-up play.
90+6' Wait! Referee Guillermo Cuadra has indicated he is going to review the Villarreal goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
90+6' Goal! Nicolas Pepe passes the ball to the feet of Etta Eyong (Villarreal), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 3:2.
90+5' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
90+3' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) commits a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.

90+1' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) shows good awareness deep inside the box as he latches on to a cross from the resulting free kick. He jumps high but his towering header lacks a little bit of accuracy and flies inches over the crossbar.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The attendance for today's match is 17620.
89' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Guillermo Cuadra saw the whole situation.
88' Here is a change. Yeremy Pino is going off and Marcelino gives the last tactical orders to Etta Eyong (Villarreal).
87' The Villarreal players are exchanging some short passes.
85' Substitution. Takefusa Kubo makes his way off the pitch and Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) comes on as his replacement.
85' Having seen unsporting behavior, Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Marcelino (Villarreal) is the recipient.
84' A goal, which was scored by Pape Gueye (Villarreal), was disallowed due to offside.
83' The corner is swung in but Villarreal can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and Villarreal manage to earn a corner.
81' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Alex Remiro comes off the line to clear the ball away.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing.
80' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Corner kick. Villarreal will have an opportunity.
78' Rough tackle by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
77' Guillermo Cuadra shows the yellow card to Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) for a heavy challenge.
76' A cross from a corner kick by Real Sociedad is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

76' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
75' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 15:4.
73' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
70' Substitution. Benat Turrientes walks off the pitch and Jon Ander Olasagasti (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
70' Marcelino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) replacing Sergi Cardona.
70' Substitution. Pape Gueye (Villarreal) replaces Dani Parejo.
70' The goal by Villarreal is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
70' The Villarreal players halt their celebrations as referee Guillermo Cuadra makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
69' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
68' Villarreal control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
66' Today's referee Guillermo Cuadra rightly decides to book Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) for his harsh tackle.
66' The ball is cleared after Thierno Barry (Villarreal) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
64' Imanol Alguacil prepares a substitution. Aihen Munoz is replaced by Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad).
64' Substitution. Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) on for Hamari Traore.
64' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
62' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
60' 2 - 2 Goal! Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) makes the score 2:2 after burying a close-range header in the right side of the goal after a good run and cross by Yeremy Pino.
60' Dangerous play by Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad). Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
59' Substitution. Denis Suarez will be replaced by Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal).
58' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
57' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
56' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
55' Logan Costa (Villarreal) commits a foul during an attacking move.
54' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
53' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
51' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Guillermo Cuadra blows for a foul.
49' 1 - 2 GOAL! And it’s the keeper’s mistake after his poor pass is easily intercepted close in by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad), who gleefully fires it into the net. That makes it 1:2.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Imanol Alguacil gives a chance to Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) and Luka Sucic is off.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45+1' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' A pass into the box finds Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the middle of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Junior Reis denies him. The ball goes behind for a corner. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
44' Denis Suarez (Villarreal) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
41' Guillermo Cuadra shows a yellow card to Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) for a tough tackle.
40' Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle. Dani Parejo (Villarreal) commits a foul after dangerous play.
39' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) bursts into the box, cuts inside his man and sends an effort just past the left post.
37' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alex Remiro is well positioned and punches the ball away.
36' What a chance! Juan Foyth (Villarreal) rises high to connect with the resulting corner inside the box, but his bullet header rattles the right post.
36' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
36' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Villarreal.
35' Neat passing move from Real Sociedad in order to create new attacking opportunities.
33' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
31' Guillermo Cuadra interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jon Martin (Real Sociedad).
30' Real Sociedad are enjoying possession, but one of the opposition players steps in to end the sequence.
28' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

28' A wonderful opportunity! Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) strikes from close range and hits the ball nicely towards the top of the net. However, Junior Reis makes a great save as he anticipates the shot and manages to parry it onto the bar. Now Real Sociedad have a corner.
27' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

26' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Real Sociedad force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
25' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
24' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Villarreal.

23' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Sociedad can continue in their attacking effort.

23' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Villarreal will have a corner.
22' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
19' 1 - 1 Goal! Junior Reis gets a hand on the penalty from Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom left corner.
19' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) is going to take the penalty!
19' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Real Sociedad!

18' There's a break in play and referee Guillermo Cuadra must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Real Sociedad using VAR. This could be interesting!
18' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
16' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

15' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
14' Denis Suarez (Villarreal) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
12' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

12' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick.
10' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
9' Real Sociedad are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper low inside the middle of the net. 1:0.
5' A quickly taken corner by Real Sociedad.

4' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Junior Reis sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner.
3' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
2' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) commits a rough challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for an infringement.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Villarreal will take the kick-off.
Guillermo Cuadra will referee today's match.
